_comment: SHADOW MANIFEST — deliberately NOT under desks/.
file anywhere under desks/ would make sync_desk_config() write a Japan desk
and source into the tracked production database on the next migration run,
which would put a non-collecting desk into public counts. It lives here so
production discovery cannot see it by accident, and a test asserts that
Nothing in this file is read by pipeline.py. Only the shadow runner reads
it, and the shadow runner writes only to the shadow state branch.

institutions.notes: The Ministry publishes for itself and, through the Joint Staff (統合幕僚監部), for the Self-Defense Forces.

sources.display_name: Japan MOD / Joint Staff — official releases
access_notes: Access qualified 2026-08-26, one honest request per endpoint.
robots.txt: 200, disallows only /a/ and /sp/j/ — every path used here is permitted.
RSS feeds: 200, application/xml, and 304 on If-None-Match.
HTML documents: 403 with Cf-Mitigated: challenge, on /j/, /en/ and /js/ alike.
Consequence: discovery and PDF bodies are collectable; HTML bodies are not.
HTML items are recorded as access_challenged and carry no body. The
challenge is not solved, worked around, or retried.
